visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand uses a spoon to stir a bubbling pot of white, milky broth. Soon after, golden-brown fried pork rinds are tossed into the pot from a light blue bowl. The background shows blurred greenery and vegetables ready for cooking. (2) The camera pans across a brightly lit buffet counter. Wooden bins are filled with various mushrooms, leafy greens like bok choy and lettuce, corn, and squashes. Top shelves hold packaged noodles and snacks in colorful orange and yellow plastic bags. (3) Tongs grip a bunch of fresh green vegetables. Close-up shots follow, showing small square tofu blocks, fish balls, and other hotpot processed foods arranged neatly in wooden trays. The lighting is crisp and highlights the freshness. (4) A large metal scoop pours thick, savory braised meat gravy over a bowl of steamed white rice. Another shot shows a slow cooker filled with a rich, dark orange curry sauce being stirred, suggesting variety in side dishes. (5) A white liquid slushie pours from a clear dispenser into a paper cup. The beverage area is shown, featuring soda fountains with Coca-Cola branding, slushie machines, and a coffee dispenser pouring a creamy latte into a cup. (6) A hand holds up a chocolate and vanilla swirl soft-serve ice cream cone against the backdrop of the restaurant's interior. The cream is smooth and glossy, with a small wafer stick inserted as a garnish. (7) A spoon lifts a sample of the rich milk broth, then transitions to another pot featuring a clear, herb-infused soup with ginger and basil leaves. In the background, plates of raw marbled beef are partially visible on the table. (8) Close-ups of raw meat plates are shown: first, bright red beef slices with intricate white marbling (US Prime Chuck), then pale pink pork collar slices. Chopsticks pick up a slice of beef and dip it into the boiling soup. (9) A seafood platter is displayed, containing large shrimp, open oysters on the half shell, and clams nestled in a bowl of ice with a lime slice. The seafood is then added to the boiling pot, creating steam and bubbles. (10) The camera shows a clean, modern restaurant interior with empty tables and light wood partitions. Finally, it cuts to the storefront of '伊根鍋屋' with a green and white logo, located on a busy city street under bright daylight.
